data.title: 不知火舞 · 练习扇上的新流苏
data.description: 练习后的道场里，舞穿靛蓝作务衣跪坐在坐垫上，把新的红流苏系到折扇柄上。她拉紧小结，展开扇面检查是否碰到扇骨，随后轻轻抖腕试出顺畅的一弧，高马尾随动作摆动。
data.action: 系紧扇柄新流苏，展开扇面轻抖手腕检查。
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui kneels on the dojo cushion in securely tied indigo samue and white tabi, fastening a new red tassel to her sensu's bamboo handle. She tightens the knot, opens the paper fan to check rib clearance, then tests a smooth wrist arc. The medium seated portrait includes the pleats across her knees. Soft morning light reveals paper texture and thread, with small rib shadows and a gentle cushion shadow beneath her folded legs.
